title: Formspec Shared Conformance Suite Case
description: Canonical shared-case contract for cross-runtime conformance checks executed by both Python and TypeScript runners.

standardValidationCode.description: Standard validation result codes that both Python and TypeScript runtimes MUST emit identically. The leading codes are the RESERVED built-in codes (core spec §2.5.1), as in validation-result.schema.json: REQUIRED, TYPE_MISMATCH, MIN_REPEAT, MAX_REPEAT, CONSTRAINT_FAILED, CONSTRAINT_PARSE_ERROR, SHAPE_FAILED, EXTERNAL_FAILED. The remaining are registry extension codes. Shape-level and external codes (e.g., 'BUDGET_SUM_MISMATCH', 'EIN_NOT_FOUND') are user-defined and not constrained here.

kind.description: Execution mode for this case. ITEM_TEXT compares resolved Item text (Core §4.2.1 text resolution and interpolation) at the listed instance paths: label / hint / description, plus the per-display-context labels / hints / descriptions a case lists (Locale §3.1.2).

definitionPath.description: Repository-relative path to the form definition fixture.

registryPaths.description: Optional repository-relative registry fixtures to load.

localePath.description: Repository-relative path to a Locale Document whose strings replace inline Item text for ITEM_TEXT cases (Locale §3.1.1–§3.1.2); runners activate its locale.

payloadPath.description: Repository-relative path to the input payload fixture.

mode.description: Validation mode to run for processing/report/response kinds.

skipScreener.description: When true, runners should skip screener entry before evaluating the main definition.

fields.description: Field declarations and values for FEL_EVALUATION cases.

compareResponseData.description: When true, RESPONSE_VALIDATION compares normalized response.data in addition to validation artifacts.

expected.description: Canonical expected output after shared normalization.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the replaced legacy test surface.

check.description: Legacy test id/name/check this case replaces.

legacyCoverage.description: Explicit mapping of this shared case to replaced legacy checks.

expected.description: Resolved Item text by instance path (e.g. 'rows[0].name'). Each entry lists label, and description / hint only when the Item has them; labels / descriptions / hints carry the per-display-context resolutions (Locale §3.1.2), listed only for contexts a Locale or the Definition supplies.
